author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹುಟ್ಟಿನೊಡನೆಯೆ ಸಾವ ಜೊತೆಗೊಯ್ದು ತಂದಿಹೆವು
ದಿಟ್ಟನಡಿಗೆಯು ಬೇಕು ನೆಟ್ಟಗುರಿಯೊಡನೆ
ಪುಟ್ಟ ಮನಸಲಿ ಎಂದು ಗಟ್ಟಿತನ ತುಂಬಿರಲು
ಹುಟ್ಟೆಂದು ಸಾರ್ಥಕವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: We came into this world carrying death with our birth;
we need a bold stride and a firmly planted goal;
if we fill even a small mind with firmness,
then birth is truly fulfilled, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Death is born with us. Given that, what matters is walking boldly toward a clear goal with a resolute mind; that is what makes a life worthwhile.
